sections.shortTitle: N -W F P Land Laws Second Amendment Ordinance 2001
sections.description:
Short title and commencement

NORTH-WEST FRONTIER PROVINCE LAND LAWS (SECOND AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE,
2001
NORTH-WEST
FRONTIER PROVINCE LAND LAWS (SECOND AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 2001
ORDINANCE XXXIV OF
2001
An Ordinance
further to amend certain land laws
[Gazette of
N.-W.F.P. Extraordinary, 20th November, 2001]
No.
1egis.I(DE)/BOR/22/7738-43, dated 20-11-2001.---The following Ordinance bye
the Governor of the North-West Frontier Province is hereby published for
general information.
1. Short title and
commencement. ---(1) This Ordinance may be called the North-West Frontier
Province Land Laws (Second Amendment) Ordinance, 2001.
(2) It shall come into force at
once.

sections.shortTitle: N -W F P Land Laws Second Amendment Ordinance 2001
sections.description:
Amendment of certain laws

2001
NORTH-WEST
FRONTIER PROVINCE LAND LAWS (SECOND AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 2001
ORDINANCE XXXIV OF
2001
An Ordinance
further to amend certain land laws
[Gazette of
N.-W.F.P. Extraordinary, 20th November, 2001]
No.
1egis.I(DE)/BOR/22/7738-43, dated 20-11-2001.---The following Ordinance bye
the Governor of the North-West Frontier Province is hereby published for
general information.
2. Amendment of certain laws.--In
the laws specified below, for the words "District Executive Officer
Revenue", wherever occurring, the words and brackets "District
Officer (Revenue and Estate)" shall be substituted:
(a) the Canal and Drainage Act,
1873 (Act VIII of 1873);
(b) the North-West Frontier
Province Tenancy Act, 1950 (N.-W.F.P. Act XXV of 1950);
(c) the West Pakistan Redemption
and Restitution of Mortgaged Lands Act, 1964 (W.P. Act XIX of 1964); and
(d) the West Pakistan Lands
Revenue Act, 1967 (W.P. Act XVIII of 1967).

[Gazette of

No.
1egis.I(DE)/BOR/22/7738-43, dated 20-11-2001.---The following Ordinance bye
the Governor of the North-West Frontier Province is hereby published for
general information.
3. Amendment of Act I of
1894.--In the Land Acquisition Act, 1894,--
(a) in section 3, in clause (c),
the words "or District Executive Officer" shall be deleted; and
(b) in sections 5, 5A, 6, 7, 17,
35, 36, 38, 39, 40, 41, 48 and 49, for the words "District-Executive
Officer Revenue", wherever occurring, the words "Revenue Appellate
Court" shall be substituted.
